title: A reference-counting cycle
description: You can read the intended cycle experiment and identify its missing dependency in this trace.

steps.description: The experiment first constructs RCHeap and allocates two pairs. You need the earlier RCHeap definition for these operations.
The intended experiment connects each pair's cdr to the other pair and increments the corresponding counts. The comments show each count staying at one after the roots are dropped.

steps.question: Where does this supplied run go when RCHeap is undefined?
steps.answer: Construction raises NameError at line 2. The except block catches it before either pair is allocated.

steps.description: You see '[gc:rc-cycle] name RCHeap is not defined' in the recorded output, with quotes around RCHeap. This run reaches the error handler rather than the cycle's live-count prints.
